label: Create Workflow Version
description: Opens a new version of a workflow, for the step after it to mark a draft, carrying whatever diagram the request brought: of the workflow an earlier step created, or else the one this request is about. A version opened empty is created bpmnAuthoritative (the diagram is the source of truth), since it has no hand-written flow nodes for a re-read of the diagram to throw away; one the request names a source for is left for the copy that follows to say.
